title: Senior Security Operations Manager
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3\.7 billion in revenue, its first billion\-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27\. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology \- hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.
   

  

 This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.
   

  

**THE ROLE**
 As a hands\-on senior leader for our India SecOps team, you will shape and safeguard Everpure’s security posture at the intersection of detection engineering, threat hunting, attack surface management, and incident response. Positioned as a strategic cornerstone in Bangalore, you will empower an elite engineering team, optimize critical SecOps pipelines, and partner cross\-functionally across global engineering and infrastructure groups. By driving execution excellence and high team morale, you ensure our enterprise platform and global telemetry remain resilient against evolving threats.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Scale \& Lead SecOps Operations: Architect, mentor, and grow the India SecOps team to foster an environment of high morale, technical excellence, and rapid execution across detection engineering and incident response.
* Proactively Manage \& Remediate Attack Surface: Own end\-to\-end Attack Surface Management (ASM) across cloud environments, SaaS applications, endpoints, and secrets management to measurably minimize enterprise exposure and mitigate risk.
* Optimize Telemetry \& Incident Response: Mature SIEM and SOAR automation pipelines to drastically reduce mean time to detect, contain, and respond (MTTD/MTTC/MTTR) while continuously elevating alert fidelity and signal confidence.
* Drive Cross\-Functional Alignment \& RCA Postmortems: Lead continuous validation through purple\-teaming and incident postmortems alongside global Infrastructure, AppSec, and Engineering teams to close control gaps and drive long\-term platform security.


**What You Bring**
* SecOps \& Leadership Mastery: Proven track record of technical and people leadership in enterprise cybersecurity, with deep expertise in detection engineering, threat hunting, incident response, and Attack Surface Management (ASM).
* Hands\-on Technical \& Tooling Expertise: Advanced proficiency with enterprise SIEM (such as Splunk), SOAR automation, EDR solutions, and cloud telemetry (AWS/Azure) with the ability to design, review, and defend security architectures.
* Engineering \& Threat\-Informed Mindset: Practical experience with detection\-as\-code practices, CI/CD pipelines, version control, and threat modeling frameworks (MITRE ATT\&CK) to systematically strengthen defenses.
* Executive Communication \& Stakeholder Management: High emotional intelligence with a demonstrated ability to navigate cross\-functional dependencies, resolve inter\-team friction productively, and translate complex security telemetry into actionable business outcomes.


**Office Location:** 
 We are primarily an in\-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Bangalore office in compliance with Everpure’s policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.
   

  

**What You Can Expect From Us**
* Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.
* Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!
* Team: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.


 And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company\-sponsored team events. Check out purebenefits.com for more information.
   

  

**Accommodations And Accessibility**
 Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at TA\-Ops@purestorage.com if you’re invited to an interview.
   

  

**Our Commitment To a Strong And Inclusive Team**
 We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.
   

  

 Everpure is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other characteristic legally protected by the laws of the jurisdiction in which you are being considered for hire.
   

  

**Join us and bring your best.**
**Bring your bold.**
**Pure and simple.**

title: Operations Manager - IT Infrastructure
description:
BETSOL is a cloud\-first digital transformation and data management company offering products and IT services to enterprises in over 40 countries. BETSOL team holds several engineering patents and is recognized with industry awards, and BETSOL maintains a net promoter score that is 2x the industry average.
   

  

 BETSOL’s open source backup and recovery product line, Zmanda (Zmanda.com), delivers up to 50% savings in total cost of ownership (TCO) and best\-in\-class performance.
   

  

 BETSOL Global IT Services (BETSOL.com) builds and supports end\-to\-end enterprise solutions, reducing time\-to\-market for its customers.
   

  

 BETSOL offices are set against the vibrant backdrops of Broomfield, Colorado, and Bangalore, India.
   

  

 We take pride in being an employee\-centric organization, offering comprehensive health insurance, competitive salaries, 401K, volunteer programs, and scholarship opportunities. Office amenities include a fitness center, cafe, and recreational facilities.
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are looking for an experienced and driven
 **Operations Manager** 
 to lead our client’s
 **IT Infrastructure** 
 function. This role is responsible for overseeing daily IT operations, managing team performance, ensuring SLA compliance, and driving continuous service improvements. The ideal candidate has a strong technical foundation in end\-user technologies, experience managing global stakeholders, and a passion for delivering high\-quality IT support services.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Team Management \& Leadership**
* Manage day\-to\-day operations of the IT Infrastructure, including ticket management, resource allocation, shift planning, and escalation handling.
* Lead and mentor Server, Storage, and Voice Engineers, fostering a high\-performance and customer\-centric culture.
* Oversee onboarding, training, and career development of IT staff.


**Operational Oversight**
* Ensure delivery of consistent support for hardware, software, and access\-related issues across the organization.
* Provide oversight across tools and platforms including:
+ Active Directory and Azure Entra for identity and access management
+ Microsoft 365, Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, SharePoint
+ Intune for endpoint management
+ Ivanti for asset and configuration management
+ Enterprise telephony platforms (NICE, LiveVox, Nexida) for user\-level provisioning and MACD tasks
+ Legal and business apps such as LegalFiles, Qlaw, and Pharos Print
+ Experience in any of the Public Cloud technologies will be an added advantage


**Reporting \& Performance Management**
* Monitor team performance and service metrics, ensuring SLA and quality targets are met.
* Generate and present weekly, monthly, and quarterly performance reports (QBRs) to IT leadership and business stakeholders.
* Use data analysis to identify trends, drive improvements, and support strategic decisions.


**Stakeholder Engagement**
* Serve as the primary point of contact for business and IT stakeholders
* Communicate effectively during incidents, escalations, and service disruptions.
* Collaborate with other IT teams (infrastructure, applications, security) to ensure seamless end\-user support.


**Process Improvement \& Compliance**
* Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), runbooks, and internal documentation.
* Identify and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency and service quality.
* Ensure adherence to internal controls, IT policies, and compliance requirements.


**Knowledge Management**
* Oversee the maintenance of the IT knowledge base, ensuring documentation is current, accessible, and aligned with common support issues.
* Promote knowledge sharing and ensure consistent support across shifts and regions.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
* Minimum 7 years of experience in IT operations, including 5\+ years in a supervisory or managerial capacity.
* Proven ability to manage distributed teams in a fast\-paced IT support environment.
* Strong experience with ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira) and understanding of ITIL frameworks.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Azure Entra, Intune, and other end\-user support technologies.
* Experience managing MACD activities in enterprise telephony platforms such as NICE, LiveVox, or Nexida is preferred.
* Excellent analytical, communication, and presentation skills.
* Experience working with U.S.\-based or international stakeholders is a strong plus.


**Additional Information**
 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Benefits Operations Manager
description:
**About Rippling**
 Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
   

  

 Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
   

  

 Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
   

  

 We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Benefits is one of Rippling's largest and most critical product categories, and the Benefits Operations organization plays a pivotal role in delivering an exceptional customer experience at scale. The team manages tens of thousands of enrollments annually while ensuring accuracy, compliance, and operational excellence.
   

  

 Rippling is seeking a Benefits Operations Manager to lead a team of Operations Supervisors responsible for multiple operational functions within Benefits. This leader will drive organizational performance through frontline leaders, establish scalable operating mechanisms, identify opportunities for automation and process optimization, and partner cross\-functionally to solve complex operational challenges.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines strong people leadership with analytical rigor, operational excellence, and the ability to influence cross\-functional stakeholders to improve customer outcomes and business performance.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Operations Supervisors, building a high\-performing organization through effective manager development and succession planning.
* Own end\-to\-end operational performance across multiple teams, including productivity, quality, SLA attainment, customer experience, and capacity utilization.
* Establish operating rhythms and review mechanisms to monitor KPIs, identify trends, and drive accountability for results.
* Drive workforce planning activities including forecasting, capacity planning, hiring strategies, and organizational design to support business growth and seasonal demand fluctuations.
* Lead cross\-functional initiatives with Product, Engineering, Sales, Customer Support, and other internal stakeholders to address systemic issues, drive alignment, and improve the customer experience.
* Lead and prioritize automation opportunities, process redesign efforts, and tooling enhancements to improve efficiency and scalability.
* Present regular business reviews to senior leadership, highlighting performance outcomes, emerging risks, operational health, and strategic initiatives.
* Proactively identify potential operational challenges and implement preventive controls to mitigate business and customer impact.


**What You Will Need**
* 6\-8 years of experience in customer\-facing operations environments such as Insurance operations, benefits operations, business operations/ product operations, or support operations.
* Minimum 3–5 years of people management experience, including direct experience leading frontline managers/ supervisors/team leaders.
* Demonstrated success managing large\-scale operations with ownership of service delivery, performance metrics, and customer outcomes.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities, with experience translating data into strategic decisions and operational improvements.
* Experience with capacity planning, workforce management, organizational design, and resource allocation.
* Proven ability to influence and partner effectively with cross\-functional stakeholders across multiple levels of the organization.
* Excellent project management and execution skills with a track record of driving complex initiatives to completion.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting to senior leadership.
* Strong proficiency with Google Workspace or Microsoft Office, particularly Sheets/Excel, for reporting and analysis; familiarity with SFDC, JIRA, and Confluence preferred.
* Ability to thrive in fast\-paced, ambiguous environments and effectively prioritize competing business needs.
* Demonstrated ownership mindset with a bias for action and continuous improvement.
* Prior experience in a SaaS or high\-growth startup environment preferred.
* Ability to work partly on U.S. hours (Eastern time zone \- EST); standard shift timings would be 1 PM \- 10 PM IST.


**Additional Information**

title: Operations Manager
description:

* Direct exposure to international clients (APAC, Europe preferred), comfortable working with multicultural stakeholders.

title: Franchise Area Manager
description:
**Job Description – Franchise Area Manager** 




**Position** 




**Franchise Area Manager** 




**Department** 





 Franchise Operations
 




**Reporting To** 





 Senior Operations Manager / Head – Franchise Operations
 




**Role Overview** 





 The Franchise Area Manager will be responsible for managing and driving the overall performance of franchise outlets within the assigned area. The role involves franchise partner management, operational excellence, sales growth, new store openings, compliance, issue resolution, and coordination with internal teams such as Finance, SCM, Marketing, Training, and Business Development.
 





 The candidate will act as the primary point of contact between the brand and franchise partners and will ensure that all outlets operate in line with brand standards and business objectives.
 




**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Franchise Partner Management** 



* Build and maintain strong relationships with franchise partners.
* Act as the primary point of contact for operational and business\-related concerns.
* Understand partner concerns and provide timely solutions.
* Conduct regular partner reviews and performance discussions.
* Ensure effective communication of brand policies, initiatives, campaigns, and operational updates.
* Drive partner engagement and improve overall partner satisfaction.



**2\. Store Operations \& Performance** 



* Monitor day\-to\-day operations of assigned franchise outlets.
* Track outlet sales, profitability, customer experience, operational compliance, and service standards.
* Identify performance gaps and prepare corrective action plans.
* Conduct regular store visits and audits.
* Ensure adherence to SOPs, food quality, hygiene, service, and brand standards.
* Follow up on operational issues until closure.



**3\. Sales \& Business Growth** 



* Drive sales growth across the assigned franchise network.
* Analyse outlet\-wise sales trends and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Track key business metrics such as sales, AOV, order volumes, discounts, online visibility, and customer ratings.
* Work with partners to improve outlet profitability.
* Identify underperforming outlets and implement action plans.
* Monitor aggregator performance across platforms such as Swiggy and Zomato.



**4\. New Store Opening / NSO** 



* Coordinate end\-to\-end new store opening activities for assigned outlets.
* Work closely with BD, Projects, SCM, Marketing, Training, Finance, and franchise partners.
* Ensure outlet readiness before launch.
* Track equipment, inventory, branding, licenses, training, aggregator onboarding, and other launch requirements.
* Ensure smooth transition from pre\-opening to post\-opening operations.
* Monitor the performance of newly opened outlets during the initial period.



**5\. Cross\-Functional Coordination** 



* Coordinate with
 
**Finance** 

 for royalty, outstanding payments, credit notes, settlements, and other partner\-related financial matters.
* Coordinate with
 
**SCM** 

 for stock availability, supply issues, transportation, and procurement concerns.
* Coordinate with
 
**Marketing** 

 for campaigns, creatives, promotions, local marketing, and NSO activities.
* Coordinate with
 
**Training** 

 to ensure franchise staff receive required product and operational training.
* Coordinate with
 
**Tech/IT** 

 for Rista, POS, aggregator, and other system\-related issues.
* Work with the
 
**Legal team** 

 for agreements, amendments, notices, and franchise\-related documentation.



**6\. Compliance \& Brand Standards** 



* Ensure franchise partners comply with all brand, statutory, and operational requirements.
* Monitor FSSAI, licenses, agreements, certificates, and other mandatory documentation.
* Conduct periodic audits and ensure closure of audit observations.
* Ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, quality, and brand standards.



**7\. Issue Resolution \& Escalation Management** 



* Take ownership of franchise partner escalations.
* Analyse root causes and provide practical solutions.
* Ensure issues are tracked and closed within agreed timelines.
* Escalate critical matters to senior management with clear facts, impact, and recommended action.
* Maintain an issue tracker and ensure there are no repeated unresolved concerns.



**8\. Reporting \& MIS** 



* Maintain regular outlet and franchise partner trackers.
* Prepare weekly/monthly performance reports.
* Track sales, collections, NSO, outlet performance, audits, complaints, and action points.
* Share business insights and improvement plans with management.
* Maintain accurate records of partner discussions and commitments.



**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** 



* Outlet Sales Growth
* Same Store Sales Growth
* Franchisee Profitability
* Franchise Partner Satisfaction
* New Store Opening Timelines
* New Store Ramp\-up Performance
* Operational Audit Scores
* Issue Resolution TAT
* Royalty / Outstanding Collection
* Aggregator Performance
* Customer Ratings \& Complaints
* SOP \& Compliance Adherence
* Partner Retention



**Required Skills** 



* Strong franchise and stakeholder management skills.
* Good understanding of retail/F\&B operations.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple franchise partners and outlets simultaneously.
* Strong ownership and follow\-through.
* Good knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets and MIS reporting.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with cross\-functional teams.
* Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned area.



**Experience \& Qualification** 



* Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PGDM preferred.
* **3–6 years of experience** 

 in franchise operations, retail, QSR, F\&B, hospitality, or similar industries.
* Prior experience in managing franchise partners and multiple outlets will be preferred.
* Experience in new store openings and outlet operations will be an added advantage.



**Key Competencies** 




**Partner Management \| Business Acumen \| Operations Excellence \| Sales Orientation \| Problem Solving \| Ownership \| Decision Making \| Communication \| Negotiation \| Team Coordination \| Analytical Thinking**

title: Credit Risk Operations Team Lead
description:
Who we are
   

  

**About Stripe**
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies \- from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups \- use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The credit risk operations team plays a critical role in ensuring a healthy financial ecosystem for businesses around the world. This team will directly impact the company's bottom line and growth capabilities by supporting new and emerging businesses. The Credit Operations team is responsible for conducting credit risk assessments, underwriting small and mid\-size users, and proposing mitigation strategies that enable Stripe to take smart risks for our users.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

 In this role, you will manage and develop a group of Credit Risk Operations Associates that are focused on commercial credit underwriting and risk mitigation. The Credit Risk Operations Team Lead will cultivate the engagement of their team members while guiding them to be the best they can be, through feedback, coaching, mentoring, and advocacy within the organization. This means helping to set team goals, and using metrics to efficiently measure and guide team performance in pursuit of those goals. To be a fit, you will have a strong operations mindset, possess a deep understanding of commercial credit risk, be able to move quickly, and be passionate about delivering an incredible user experience.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Manage, coach, and develop a new team of in\-office Credit Risk Operations Associates
* Execute on commercial credit underwriting frameworks that allow your team to evaluate business models and financial statements of successful venture\-backed startups to established entities
* Guide your team to identify commercial credit risk and propose risk mitigation strategies
* Drive strong operational delivery and process improvement helping to maintain credit risk tolerance and balance credit loss and customer experience
* Build a great culture and ensure team members are happy, effective, and growing in their career
* Set clear goals and direction, and provide regular feedback on team members’ performance
* Be data\-driven in your analysis of performance, and in your decision making
* Transmit and foster our values, serving as a beacon of Stripe’s user\-centric philosophy and culture of transparency, empathy, inclusion, and empowerment
* Manage operational performance to deliver KPIs
* Manage capacity and scheduling to ensure adequate coverage
* Help resolve roadblocks and issues as they arise
* Act as a point of escalation for complex credit underwriting reviews


 Who you are
   

  

 We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
   

  

**Minimum Requirements**
* A minimum of 6\+ years of experience with commercial credit underwriting, financial statement analysis, risk modeling and cash flow forecasting
* The ability to transform business and financial data into a cohesive narrative that outlines potential credit risks and presents dynamic mitigation strategies
* At least 2\+ years of direct people management experience
* Leadership skills, strong analytical abilities, and excellent communication skills are essential
* An ability to partner effectively with internal globally distributed stakeholders
* Strong operational background including new process launches and service delivery
* Skill and credibility doing the core work of a user facing team with a high bar for quality, and a willingness to lead by example
* Passion for process improvement and innovation


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Degree/diploma in Finance or Accounting, or a related field
* Experience in payments, e\-commerce, or fintech mitigating credit risk
* Experience in building and scaling new teams


 In\-office expectations
   

  

 Office\-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in\-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in\-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
   

  

 Pay and benefits
   

  

 Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.
   

  

 We look forward to hearing from you.
   

  

 At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.
   

  

 Apply now

Join us in shaping the future.

 Execution Manager
   

  

**Department:** 
 Project Execution / Operations

 Bengaluru
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
   

  

**Reporting To:** 
 Operations Head / Business Head
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The Execution Manager will be responsible for
 **planning, coordinating, monitoring, and successfully completing interior projects within the agreed timeline, budget, quality standards, and scope** 
 .
   

  

 The person will act as the key link between the client, design team, sales team, procurement team, vendors, site engineers, and installation teams.
   

  

 The role requires strong ownership of project timelines, site progress, workmanship, material availability, team productivity, and client satisfaction.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Project Handover \& Planning
* Take complete project handover from the Sales and Design teams.
* Understand approved designs, drawings, BOQs, specifications, materials, and client requirements.
* Review project scope, timelines, dependencies, and execution requirements before commencing work.
* Prepare a detailed project execution plan and milestone schedule.
* Identify potential execution challenges before work begins.
* Ensure all required drawings, measurements, approvals, and material specifications are available before execution.
* Site Execution Management
* Take overall responsibility for the execution of assigned interior projects.
* Monitor day\-to\-day progress across multiple project sites.
* Ensure execution is carried out strictly as per approved drawings and specifications.
* Coordinate civil, electrical, plumbing, false ceiling, painting, carpentry, modular installation, stone/countertop, glass, hardware, and other interior works.
* Ensure work is completed according to the approved sequence and project schedule.
* Conduct regular site inspections.
* Resolve site\-level issues quickly to avoid delays.
* Project Scheduling \& Timeline Management
* Prepare and monitor project\-wise execution schedules.
* Establish clear start and completion dates for each activity.
* Track critical milestones and dependencies.
* Ensure materials, manpower, and vendors are available according to the schedule.
* Identify delays and take corrective action immediately.
* Escalate major risks or timeline deviations to management.
* Ensure projects are completed within the committed handover timeline.
* Manpower \& Vendor Management
* Allocate and coordinate manpower across project sites.
* Manage carpenters, electricians, plumbers, painters, ceiling teams, installers, fabricators, and other site workers.
* Coordinate with external contractors and vendors.
* Monitor vendor performance, productivity, workmanship, and timelines.
* Ensure sufficient manpower is available at critical stages of the project.
* Address manpower shortages and vendor\-related delays proactively.
* Maintain strong working relationships with reliable vendors and contractors.
* Material \& Procurement Coordination
* Coordinate with the Procurement and Stores teams to ensure timely availability of materials.
* Track material requirements against the project schedule.
* Ensure materials delivered to site match approved specifications.
* Prevent material shortages from affecting execution.
* Monitor material handling and storage at site.
* Identify damaged, incorrect, or missing materials immediately.
* Coordinate replacements and rectification wherever required.
* Quality Control
* Ensure all work meets Vaastukalpaa's quality standards.
* Conduct regular quality inspections at various stages of execution.
* Check dimensions, alignment, finishing, hardware installation, joints, edges, laminates, shutters, electrical points, plumbing, and other execution details.
* Ensure execution matches approved designs and drawings.
* Identify defects and ensure rectification within defined timelines.
* Conduct pre\-handover quality inspections.
* Maintain a strong focus on finishing quality and attention to detail.
* Client Coordination
* Act as the primary execution point of contact for the client wherever required.
* Provide clients with regular updates on project progress.
* Coordinate site visits and execution\-related discussions.
* Understand and address client concerns professionally.
* Manage client expectations regarding timelines, site conditions, and execution limitations.
* Ensure any client\-requested changes are properly documented and approved before execution.
* Maintain a positive client experience throughout the project.
* Change Request \& Additional Work Management
* Identify changes requested by clients after design approval.
* Coordinate with the Design and Sales teams for scope validation.
* Ensure additional work is not executed without appropriate approval.
* Communicate cost and timeline implications of changes to the concerned teams.
* Maintain proper documentation of approved changes.
* Ensure revised requirements are communicated to all relevant execution teams.

**Work Closely With**

* Design Team

* Estimation Team
* Procurement Team
* Stores / Logistics
* Site Engineers
* Vendors and Contractors

 Job Qualification

 Experience leading global support programs, service priorities and cross\-functional execution against measurable outcomes.

 Strong ability to diagnose data issues, assess business impact, coordinate ownership and drive timely resolution.

**Process Improvement :** 
 Demonstrated success simplifying workflows, reducing manual effort and improving service efficiency, quality and consistency.
   

  

**Communication \& Execution :** 
 Excellent written and verbal communication, sound judgment, urgency and disciplined follow\-through in a support environment.

title: Senior Manager, Global Production Planning
description:
Fluence (Nasdaq: FLNC) is a global market leader delivering intelligent energy storage and optimization software for renewables and storage. Our solutions and operational services are helping to create a more resilient grid and unlock the full potential of renewable portfolios. With gigawatts of successful implementations across nearly 50 markets, we are transforming the way we power our world for a more sustainable future. For more information, please visit fluenceenergy.com.
   

  

**Job Description**
**ABOUT FLUENCE**
 Fluence, a Siemens and AES company, is the global market leader in energy storage technology solutions and services. Fluence is creating a more sustainable future by combining the agility of a technology company with the expertise and vision of two respected industry leaders.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The Sr. Manager, Global Production Planning leads Fluence’s global production planning function across the contract manufacturing network. This role translates business priorities and customer demand into executable production plans by balancing material availability, manufacturing capacity, contractual commitments, operational constraints, and risk.
   

  

 Operating at the M5 people\-leader level, the role manages multiple related planning teams or workstreams, establishes departmental priorities, allocates resources, and implements strategic planning policies. The Sr. Manager also owns global Clear\-to\-Build (CTB) governance and executive reporting, ensuring leaders have accurate visibility to manufacturing readiness, constraints, recovery plans, and decisions required to protect business outcomes.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Global Production Planning and Strategy**
* Lead the global production planning function across manufacturing sites and contract manufacturers, establishing priorities, operating rhythms, and performance expectations aligned with business objectives.
* Develop and govern an integrated production plan that balances customer demand, contractual delivery requirements, material availability, factory capacity, labor, logistics, and other operational constraints.
* Implement strategic planning policies, methods, and evaluation criteria; assure adherence to approved schedules, work plans, budgets, and performance requirements.
* Lead weekly, monthly, and longer\-range planning reviews, converting complex data and organizational objectives into clear decisions, trade\-offs, and actions.
* Identify systemic production risks and direct scenario analysis, mitigation, escalation, and recovery planning to protect customer and business commitments.


**Clear\-to\-Build Management and Executive Reporting**
* Own the global CTB process, governance, definitions, reporting cadence, and accountability model across the manufacturing network.
* Consolidate factory readiness, material availability, capacity, and schedule information into an accurate global CTB view with clear assumptions and data ownership.
* Provide concise executive reporting on production outlook, material and capacity constraints, schedule exposure, recovery options, and decisions required.
* Drive improvements in CTB data quality, planning\-system integration, reporting automation, and forecast accuracy.
* Ensure critical issues are escalated with quantified business impact, accountable owners, decision dates, and executable recovery plans.


**People Leadership and Resource Management**
* Lead, hire, develop, and retain a high\-performing global planning team; set clear goals, define roles, manage performance, and build succession and capability plans.
* Manage multiple related planning teams or workstreams, set departmental priorities, and allocate resources to the highest\-value business needs.
* Coach managers and planning professionals in decision quality, stakeholder influence, structured problem solving, and executive communication.
* Establish measurable team objectives and operating metrics, and hold the organization accountable for delivery, quality, and continuous improvement.


**Cross\-Functional Leadership and Planning Excellence**
* Persuade managers and senior leaders to take action on complex, sensitive planning matters and negotiate effectively with external manufacturing partners, vendors, and suppliers.
* Build strong formal networks across Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Procurement, Logistics, Program Management, Commercial, Finance, Quality, Engineering, and contract manufacturing partners.
* Standardize global planning processes, governance, controls, and operating procedures while enabling appropriate regional and site\-level execution.
* Lead cross\-functional improvement initiatives that strengthen planning maturity, decision speed, resilience, and scalability across the manufacturing network.
* Support strategic capacity, footprint, supplier, and operational\-readiness initiatives required for business growth.


**Qualifications And Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Operations, Business, or a related field; Master’s degree preferred.
* Typically 12\+ years of progressive experience in production planning, supply planning, manufacturing operations, or integrated business planning, including significant global or multi\-site responsibility.
* Demonstrated people\-leadership experience, including responsibility for hiring, goal setting, performance management, development planning, and resource allocation across related teams or workstreams.
* Proven experience leading production planning within a contract manufacturing and supplier network environment.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze complex operational situations using in\-depth knowledge of organizational objectives and translate findings into strategic policies, priorities, and executable plans.
* Executive\-level communication and influence skills, including the ability to persuade leaders, navigate sensitive trade\-offs, and negotiate with external partners.
* Experience establishing planning governance, performance metrics, schedules, work plans, and budget accountability.
* Strong capability in scenario planning, risk management, recovery planning, data quality, and planning\-process automation.
* ASCM CPIM or CSCP certification preferred.


**LEADERSHIP IMPACT**
 Success in this role is measured by the reliability and transparency of the global production plan, the quality and timeliness of CTB decisions, the organization’s ability to anticipate and recover from constraints, and the strength of the planning team. Decisions made in this position can materially affect production schedules, unit operations, customer commitments, and broader business activities.
   

  

**Our Culture**
 At Fluence, our culture is the foundation that drives our ambitious growth strategy and fuels our mission to transform the future of energy. Our core cultural pillars empower us to innovate, collaborate, and lead with purpose, ensuring we continue to deliver unparalleled value to our customers and the world.
   

  

**Unleash Voices**
 We believe every voice matters. We encourage openness, active listening, and decisive action to create a culture where everyone has the opportunity to contribute to our success. We foster an environment where diverse perspectives are heard and valued, driving innovation and progress.
   

  

**Customer Fluent**
 Our customers are at the heart of everything we do. We’re committed to delivering exceptional value that exceeds expectations by understanding our customers' needs and adapting swiftly to meet them. Our deep focus on customer satisfaction drives us to continuously improve and innovate.
   

  

**Infinite Impact**
 We are committed to creating the impossible. We push boundaries to deliver sustainable, game\-changing solutions that shape a brighter, more energy\-efficient future for all. Our team is passionate about making a lasting impact that will resonate for generations to come.
   

  

**All In**
 We are all in for growth. Our teams are relentlessly focused on identifying and seizing opportunities that propel us forward. We embrace an ownership mindset, pushing ourselves and each other to accelerate progress and create lasting success.

We work directly with frontier AI lab researchers to create evaluations, publish benchmarks, and push the boundary of data. We’ve grown from $0 to \~$1B run rate and pay \~$60M to over 30K individuals every month.
   

  

**Why Join Handshake Now**
* Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel
* Partner hand\-in\-hand with world\-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners and the world’s top educational institutions
* Work together with engineers, scientists, operators, and more from Palantir, Meta, Scale AI, and former YC founders
* Build a massive, fast\-growing business with billions in revenue


**About Handshake AI**
 Human data is the core infrastructure to AI advancement. Frontier AI labs currently improve model capabilities with various data\-intensive post\-training techniques. We believe that data spend for AI training will increase by 3\-5x in the next few years and continue for much longer as models take on new domains. Handshake AI supports all of the frontier AI labs, working on their most complex data at the largest scale.
   

  

 We are building our India team to help accelerate the development of frontier models. This team is a critical, strategic investment for us \- we have grown the team 3x in the past six months to help fuel our next phase of growth. India\-based teammates will work hand\-in\-hand with US\-based teams to scope, execute, and deliver critical human data projects to Frontier Labs and other customers.
   

  

**The Role**
 As a Strategic Projects Lead (SPL), you will own the execution of large\-scale human data programs that directly power frontier AI model training and evaluation. Working hands\-on with leading AI labs and technology companies, you will make real\-time decisions that affect revenue, margins, delivery quality, and long\-term customer relationships.
   

  

**Role**
 This is a high\-ownership, outcomes\-driven role for operators who thrive in ambiguity, move fast with incomplete information, and are accountable for results at scale. What you'll do:
   

  

* Own end\-to\-end execution of multi\-week to multi\-month AI data programs to deliver double\-digit millions in ARR\-equivalent impact
* Lead and coordinate hundreds to thousands of expert Fellows to meet aggressive delivery timelines while maintaining quality and cost targets
* Design and adapt staffing models, incentives, and workflows to improve throughput, margins, and delivery reliability under changing requirements
* Partner directly with frontier AI labs and senior stakeholders to shape scope, resolve issues, and expand programs through execution


**You Have**
* 6\+ years of experience in technical or analytical roles such as software engineering, data, analytics, or technical product.
* A technical degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or similar and/or hands\-on experience with coding (Python, SQL, or similar).
* Strong analytical and first\-principles problem\-solving skills applied to scaling operations
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, including with senior customers
* High ownership mindset with pride in end\-to\-end accountability
* Curiosity and ability to quickly learn technical AI concepts and industry trends


**Bonus Points**
* Experience managing large, distributed workforces or marketplaces
* Exposure to AI data, model evaluation, or technical services delivery
* Background in productOps, investment banking, private equity, or management consulting


**You’ll Thrive Here If You**
* Are motivated by solving operational problems that have direct, measurable impact.
* Want to be part of a company shaping the future of AI through human data.
* Can navigate ambiguity, act with urgency, and keep multiple workstreams moving in parallel.


**Perks**
* Generous Equity Grant vested over 4 years
* Housing Bonus: 1\.3 Lakhs spread throughout the first year
* Well Defined Performance Bonus ranging between 10 \- 100% of base
* Medical Insurance Coverage
* Food credit for every in person day.

title: Manager / Director – Staffing Delivery (IT Services)
description:
**Why VARITE** 




  





 Every day, VARITE connects the world's leading enterprises with the talent that powers their technology initiatives. We are a global staffing and IT consulting partner delivering contract and permanent staffing to Fortune 1000 companies across the USA, UK, UAE, Canada, Ireland, and India.
 



  





 Our 1,500\+ member global team supports leading technology, financial services, automotive, defense, energy, life sciences, semiconductor, and engineering companies.
 



  





 Our performance speaks for itself: winner of the Magnit Global Supplier Excellence Award, Cisco Business Growth Award, Pinnacle Premier Supplier Award, and People Scout Select Supplier Award.
 



  





 Winning is in our DNA. VARITE is ranked among the Top 3 suppliers by most of our clients, and we intend to keep it that way.
 



  





 We are looking for hard hitters who share that DNA: leaders who set the pace for the industry, develop great people as mentors, and deliver results month after month. If you have built delivery engines, not just teams, this is your seat at the table.
 



  





**The Role** 




 We are hiring a Manager or Director – Staffing Delivery (level based on experience) to own high\-volume delivery for our large IT Services clients. You will run the business end to end: client relationships, recruitment teams, ATS governance, AI\-enabled productivity, delivery metrics, and P\&L.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 




 • Own and consistently deliver 50\+ placements per month across your client portfolio.
 



 • Own the P\&L for your delivery portfolio: revenue, gross margin, headcount productivity, and cost of delivery.
 



 • Drive recruiter productivity: set and manage clear per\-recruiter targets for submittals, interviews, and placements.
 



 • Drive core staffing metrics: submittal\-to\-interview, interview\-to\-offer, offer\-to\-join ratios, time\-to\-submit, and fill rate.
 



 • Use AI tools across sourcing, screening, matching, and reporting to increase speed and quality of delivery, and lead team\-wide AI adoption.
 



 • Establish and enforce ATS governance on JobDiva / Ceipal: data hygiene, pipeline discipline, activity tracking, and reporting accuracy.
 



 • Build and deepen relationships with delivery heads, TA leaders, and procurement stakeholders at large IT Services companies to grow wallet share.
 



 • Maintain top\-tier supplier rankings through scorecard\- and SLA\-driven performance management.
 



 • Present business reviews, delivery dashboards, and growth plans to clients and VARITE leadership with clarity and confidence.
 



 • Lead, coach, and scale high\-performing recruitment teams with a culture of accountability.
 



  





**What You Bring** 




 • Proven track record of delivering 50\+ placements per month in IT staffing for IT Services / ISV clients.
 



 • Demonstrated ability to raise recruiter productivity through targets, coaching, and process discipline.
 



 • A proven mentor who builds leaders, not just recruiters, and is recognized in the industry for delivery excellence.
 



 • Highly AI\-savvy: hands\-on use of AI tools for sourcing, screening, and workflow automation, with a clear view of how AI changes recruiting operations.
 



 • Strong hands\-on experience and governance of ATS platforms, specifically JobDiva and/or Ceipal.
 



 • Deep, active connections with large IT Services companies at decision\-maker level.
 



 • Demonstrated P\&L ownership with measurable revenue and margin outcomes.
 



 • Metrics\-first mindset: you manage the business through data, not instinct.
 



 • Excellent presentation and executive communication skills; comfortable leading QBRs and leadership reviews.
 



 • Experience with scorecards, VMS platforms, and contingent workforce models.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




 • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field. MBA preferred.
 



 • Manager: 8–12 years in IT staffing delivery, including team leadership.
 



 • Director: 12\+ years in IT staffing delivery, including P\&L ownership and leading multi\-level teams.
 



  





**Location:** 
  Bengaluru or Gurgaon, India
 



  





**Work Mode:** 
 Work from Office (5 days). This is not a hybrid or remote role.
 



  





**Ready to lead delivery at scale? Apply now.**

title: Logistics Sourcing Intelligence Manager
description:
This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge\-to\-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.
   

  

**Job Description**
**HPE Operations** 
 is our innovative IT services organization. It provides the expertise to advise, integrate, and accelerate our customers’ outcomes from their digital transformation. Our teams collaborate to transform insight into innovation. In today’s fast paced, hybrid IT world, being at business speed means overcoming IT complexity to match the speed of actions to the speed of opportunities. Deploy the right technology to respond quickly to market possibilities. Join us and redefine what’s next for you.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 The Logistics Sourcing Intelligence Manager is a leadership role within the Global Logistics \& Spares Supply Chain Sourcing (GLSS) organization, responsible for managing logistics sourcing intelligence deliverables across various transportation modes, including air, ocean, surface, warehousing, brokerage, and related logistics services.
   

  

 This role enables fact\-based sourcing decisions, sustainable savings, cost avoidance, and commercial governance by building consistent analytics practices across RFIs, RFQs, solutioning support, rate benchmarking, spend analytics, and savings / avoidance reporting.
   

  

 The manager is expected to bring broad logistics commercial understanding and strong procurement process knowledge, including Source\-to\-Contract (S2C), RFQ governance, supplier evaluation, negotiation analytics, sourcing tools such as Coupa Sourcing Optimizer, and executive\-ready reporting.
   

  

 The position strengthens GLSS capability by developing talent, standardizing sourcing intelligence methods, driving digital and AI\-enabled analytics adoption, and ensuring that insights translate into practical sourcing actions and measurable business value.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Leadership \& Development
* Lead, coach, and develop logistics sourcing intelligence managers supporting multiple transportation modes and regions.
* Set clear priorities, operating rhythms, quality expectations, and development plans for the team.
* Build a high\-performing analytics culture focused on ownership, stakeholder impact, business acumen, and continuous improvement.
* Provide guidance on complex sourcing analytics, commercial interpretation, and executive\-ready storytelling without needing to be the deepest mode expert in every area.
* Logistics Commercial Intelligence Across Modes
* Own the common logistics commercial intelligence framework across air, ocean, surface, warehousing, brokerage, and related service categories.
* Guide teams in interpreting freight rate structures, accessorials, fuel mechanisms, lane / network impacts, capacity dynamics, service trade\-offs, and supplier commercial proposals.
* Ensure consistent benchmarking, rate normalization, scenario modeling, and total cost comparison methods across sourcing events.
* Translate logistics market signals and commercial trends into practical recommendations for sourcing strategy, cost mitigation, and supply chain resilience.
* Source\-to\-Contract, RFQ \& Solutioning Support
* Provide leadership oversight across the S2C process, including RFI, RFQ, supplier response management, scenario analysis, evaluation support, recommendation development, and award readiness.
* Partner with sourcing managers and solutioning teams to shape sourcing event design, bid templates, evaluation criteria, baseline assumptions, and negotiation targets.
* Drive standardized RFQ governance, including data readiness, bid validation, supplier comparability, savings logic, auditability, and decision documentation.
* Support solutioning work by helping teams connect logistics requirements, service design, supplier capabilities, cost models, and operational constraints.
* Procurement Tools, Coupa Enablement \& Digital Process Adoption
* Provide functional leadership on procurement and sourcing tools, including Coupa or similar S2P / S2C platforms, to improve sourcing event execution and governance.
* Define business requirements for digital RFQs, sourcing dashboards, analytics workflows, and future\-state process improvements.
* Partner with digital, IT, sourcing operations, and business users to improve tool adoption, process compliance, and data quality.
* Promote AI\-enabled analytics, automation, and reusable reporting models to improve productivity and decision quality across GLSS.
* Spend Analytics, Savings \& Avoidance Governance
* Lead logistics spend analytics across modes to identify cost trends, demand shifts, rate risks, supplier concentration, and sourcing opportunities.
* Ensure consistent savings and cost avoidance methodologies, including baseline management, negotiated vs. realized savings tracking, benefit validation, and leakage identification.
* Build executive\-ready reporting on sourcing performance, spend movement, commercial outcomes, and value delivery.
* Use analytics to support budgeting, business planning, supplier reviews, and leadership decision\-making.
* Stakeholder, Supplier \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration
* Act as a interface between sourcing, finance, contracts, operations, partner management, digital teams, and regional stakeholders.
* Influence sourcing and operations leaders through clear insights, structured recommendations, and strong commercial reasoning.
* Support supplier\-facing discussions by preparing fact\-based views on pricing, service performance, competitive benchmarks, and negotiation levers.
* Create alignment across global stakeholders while balancing standardization with regional business needs..


**What You Need To Bring**
***Education and Experience Required:***
* 12\-16\+ years of experience in logistics sourcing, transportation procurement, sourcing intelligence, procurement analytics, supply chain analytics, or logistics commercial roles.
* Demonstrated experience leading people, including coaching, setting priorities, reviewing output quality, and developing talent.
* Broad logistics commercial knowledge across multiple modes; depth in one mode is helpful but not mandatory if the candidate can connect commercial principles across categories.
* Strong understanding of Source\-to\-Contract processes, RFI / RFQ execution, supplier evaluation, negotiation support, and sourcing governance.
* Experience supporting sourcing events through spend analysis, rate benchmarking, scenario modeling, savings calculations, and leadership recommendations.
* Comfort working with global stakeholders in fast\-paced, matrixed environments.


**Knowledge And Skills**
**Analytical, Digital \& Tooling Skills**
* Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint for analytics, modeling, synthesis, and executive communication.
* Experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar visualization platforms; SQL or data querying capability preferred.
* Working knowledge of procurement and sourcing platforms such as Coupa, SAP Ariba, Ivalua, or similar S2P / S2C tools.
* Ability to define analytics requirements, improve data quality, standardize dashboards, and support digital RFQ / sourcing processes.
* Familiarity with AI\-enabled analytics, automation use cases, and digital transformation concepts is a plus.


**Professional Attributes**
* People\-first leader with strong coaching, prioritization, and team development skills.
* Commercially sharp, analytically structured, and comfortable making trade\-offs with imperfect data.
* Strong communicator who can simplify complex logistics and sourcing topics for senior stakeholders.
* Governance\-oriented mindset with focus on accuracy, consistency, transparency, and auditability.
* Curious, proactive learner with passion for sourcing intelligence, digital enablement, and AI\-led productivity improvement.

If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.

 We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

title: Head of Foundry Operations, India
description:
Imagine working at the forefront of innovation in fluid\-flow technology, with over 1,400 colleagues across the globe, and contributing to a legacy of excellence that spans eight manufacturing facilities on four continents. Armstrong Fluid Technology is more than just a leader in our industry; we are a community of the brightest and most creative minds, driven by a shared mission to engineer the future and safeguard our planet.
 



  





 As part of our team, you'll be immersed in an environment that fosters growth, creativity, and collaboration. Here, you'll have the opportunity to push boundaries, tackle exciting challenges, and develop cutting\-edge solutions that promote energy efficiency and reduce environmental impact. Every day offers the chance to make a meaningful contribution to a more sustainable future, driving innovations that help lower global carbon footprints. Together, we’re creating a legacy that goes beyond business—one that’s changing the world for the better.
 



  





 In this role, you will lead our India foundry operations with full accountability for production excellence opereational trainformation, and strategic growth. You'll drive the facility's evolution from tradition bronze casting to advanced stainless steel manufacturing, implementing automation and lean practices that position us for future. As a key member of our global opreations leadership team, you'll ensure our India foundry delivers world\-class quality, maintains optimal inventory levels, and serves our global customer base with excellence while fostering a positive, engaged workforce culture
 



  





**Key Accountabilities** 




**Operations Leadership \& Performance**

* Provide strategic direction and operational oversight for the transition from bronze to stainless steel casting capabilities by conducting feasibility studies, process development, and qualification activities.
* Drive achievement of key performance metrics including safety, quality, delivery, cost, and productivity targets across all production areas \[Automation \& Operational Excellence] including sustainability initiatives that reduce waste, energy consumption, and environmental impact \[Financial Management \& Strategic Planning].
* Support and lead the automation transformation roadmap for the foundry, identifying and implementing technologies that improve efficiency, quality, and capacity.
* Work with engineering teams to design, specify, and commission automated systems for core making, casting, finishing, and material handling processes including to ensure new material capabilities meet customer requirements and quality standards.
* Coordinate changes to production workflows and layouts to maximize the benefits of automation investments.
* Lead/sponsor continuous improvement initiatives using lean manufacturing principles and problem\-solving methodologies \[Operations, Supply Chain \& Inventory Management].
* Support optimization of secondary supplier relationships for raw materials, consumables, tooling, and outsourced services to ensure quality, reliability, and cost
* Work with supply chain teams to create and monitor inventory management plans that maintain 95% safety stock availability in the HUB at all times.
* Coordinate changes to procurement strategies and supplier partnerships that reduce lead times and improve material flow.
* Participate in supplier development programs and quality improvement initiatives with key vendors.



  





**People Development \& Employee Relations :** 



* Support the development of a highly skilled, engaged, and motivated workforce through effective talent management, training programs, and career development
* Work with HR teams to create and monitor employee engagement strategies that build trust, transparency, and open communication across all levels.
* Coordinate changes to compensation, benefits, and recognition programs that are competitive and equitable.
* Participate in the cultivation of a positive workplace culture that emphasizes safety, respect, collaboration, and continuous learning, reducing the risk of unionization through proactive employee relations \[Material Transition Strategy].
* Support the maintenance of world\-class safety performance with a goal of zero incidents through robust safety management systems and continuous risk
* Work with quality teams to create and monitor quality assurance processes that ensure 100% conformance to customer specifications and industry
* Coordinate changes to ensure full compliance with all environmental, health, safety, and regulatory requirements.
* Support the development and management of annual operating budgets, capital investment plans, and financial forecasts for the foundry.
* Work with finance teams to create and monitor cost reduction initiatives and productivity improvement programs that enhance profitability.
* Coordinate changes to manufacturing strategies aligned with corporate objectives and market demands.
* Participate in business reviews with senior leadership, providing insights and recommendations on operational performance and strategic opportunities



  





**What We're Looking for** 




**To thrive in this role, you should bring:** 




**Education and Experience** 



* Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or equivalent technical discipline.
* 15\-18 years of progressive experience in foundry or casting operations, with at least 5\-7 years in senior leadership roles managing engineering, manufacturing, and distribution operations in an industrial environment.
* Demonstrated knowledge of ferrous and non\-ferrous casting processes, metallurgy principles, foundry equipment, and industry best
* Proven track record of leading operational transformations, including automation implementation and material/process transitions.
* Experience managing multi\-cultural teams and driving change in complex organizational environments.
* Knowledge of Indian labor laws, industrial regulations, policies, and
* Experience with lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies strongly preferred.

title: Principal Enterprise Delivery Manager
description:
**Overview**
**Working at Atlassian**
 Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
   

  

**Why should you apply to this role?**
 The Principal Enterprise Delivery Manager is responsible for ushering Atlassian’s largest, most complex customers through their transition into the cloud. As the primary stakeholder, you will act as a reliable strategic advisor and technical consultant to senior customer decision\-makers, while also leading the delivery and governance of large\-scale Cloud migrations.
   

  

 You bring both business acumen and technical fluency. You will work closely with customer stakeholders and cross\-functional teams—including Sales, Solutions, Support, Product Management, Channel Partners, and Engineering—to help navigate architectural decisions, risk mitigation, performance guardrails, and adoption planning.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of strategy, data, and execution — whether you come from delivery management, DevOps, QA/testing, or engineering. It requires proven expertise in developing and influencing customer cloud strategies and enabling technical adoption of cloud features, including AI. You understand how data moves, systems integrate, and migrations succeed (or fail). You will identify potential challenges and implement effective solutions that guide toward positive outcomes and ultimately lead Atlassian’s most strategic customers to Cloud.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Migration Strategy:** 
 Lead end\-to\-end cloud transformation engagements by evaluating customer environments and aligning technical execution with business outcomes.
   

  

* Risk Management: Facilitate migration readiness assessments, interpret guardrail results, and recommend actionable remediations (i.e. SQL\-based analysis, app remediations, automation deltas, workflow redesign).
* Technical Architecture: Understand and communicate the role of APIs, webhooks, and automation components in customer environments — explaining how they translate to Cloud and what requires refactor or replacement.
* Trusted Advisor: Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and other technical executives, guiding decision\-making through data\-backed insights.
* Delivery Excellence: Govern the migration lifecycle through disciplined execution, measurable outcomes, and coordination with support \& engineering teams — from discovery to UAT completion and go\-live.
* Drive Accountability: Drive team accountability through clearly defined milestones, transparent reporting, proactive risk management and optimal resourcing.
* Stakeholder Management: Lead all project communications, plan reviews, and steering committee to guide project direction. Maintain effective communication with stakeholders to advocate for the team and meet customer objectives.
* Escalation Management: Act as the escalation point for customers to drive urgency on critical blockers during migrations.
* Team Leadership: Mentor peers on technical literacy and lead internal enablement efforts, including training workshops and playbook development. Model a consultative, data\-driven mindset expected of Atlassian’s delivery leaders.


**Industry Insight:** 
 Stay ahead of industry trends and integrate insights into customer interactions. Propose innovative solutions to business challenges.
   

  

**Compensation**
 At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
   

  

 This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Qualifications
   

  

* Extensive experience working in or around software delivery — roles such as Delivery Manager, DevOps Engineer, QA/Test Lead, Systems Engineer, or Support Lead are a plus
* Proven track record leading data migration, systems integrations, or platform transformations.
* Knowledge of APIs, automations, and integration patterns, including how they translate between on\-prem and cloud.
* Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) — able to connect process, tooling, and delivery outcomes.
* Strong ability to influence customer decision\-making through expertise in delivery knowledge and value discussions.
* Skilled in negotiating effectively with senior\-level decision\-makers and c\-suite executives.
* Demonstrated leadership, teamwork, and mentorship skills that enhance team learning and engagement.
* Over 10 years of professional experience as a technical program/delivery manager responsible for complex technology projects for enterprise customers.
* Bachelor’s or advanced degree in engineering, computer science, or equivalent professional experience.


**Benefits \& Perks**
 Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit
 **go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits** 
**.**
**About Atlassian**
 At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.
   

  

 We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
   

  

 To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.
   

  

 To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit

title: Director of AI Labs Business

 Joveo builds AI\-powered recruiting technology. We are building a team to deliver specialist human data and AI evaluation programs, with expert judgment at the centre of the work.
 



 We are hiring a director to shape this capability and build the organisation that delivers it.
 



  





**🌟 About the role** 




 Build the function that turns specialist human expertise into AI data and evaluations customers can rely on.
 



 You will work with Joveo leadership to shape the offering, hire the managers who deliver it and establish the standards we commit to. Your remit includes customer delivery and portfolio economics, with influence over the tools and capabilities we develop.
 



 For someone who has already led complex AI programs, this is an opportunity to put that experience to work across an entire function. You will help decide which opportunities we pursue, what a successful pilot must demonstrate and how we grow without losing control of quality or cost.
 



  





**🧠 What you’ll do** 



* Shape the offering with leadership. Identify the customer problems we can solve well, define the deliverables and acceptance standards, and establish what we need to prove before expanding a service.
* Build the delivery leadership team. Hire and develop program managers and specialist leads. Give them clear accountability and decision rights, and plan expert capacity around qualified demand.
* Establish quality standards across programs. Set expectations for expert qualification, calibration, adjudication and measurement. Work with technical specialists to challenge weak metrics and keep evaluation conclusions defensible.
* Lead senior customer conversations. Translate technical needs into realistic commitments, resolve difficult escalations and use customer feedback to improve the offering. Help turn successful pilots into repeat programs.
* Own delivery economics across the portfolio. Understand the full cost of expert supply, technical integration and rework. Partner with commercial teams on pricing, scope changes and capacity decisions.
* Shape tooling priorities with engineering. Turn recurring delivery problems into reusable capabilities, make deliberate choices about automation and maintain strong practices for customer data protection and traceability.



  





**🎯 What we’re looking for** 



* You have built or led a delivery, operations or technical program function in AI data, evaluation, applied AI or a closely related field.
* You have hired or developed managers and held responsibility for complex customer outcomes. You can build a team that makes good decisions without every issue reaching you.
* You are credible in both a technical review and a commercial discussion. You can challenge an evaluation design, identify weak acceptance criteria and work through the implications for delivery and cost.
* You have made consequential operating decisions: narrowing an offering, resetting a customer commitment, changing a quality system or rebuilding a team. You can explain your reasoning and the results.
* Experience launching a service, turning pilots into repeat programs or operating expert contributor networks is especially relevant.



 We will look at the scope you have carried and the judgment you have developed. Your record of building a function matters more than the title you currently hold.
 



  





**✨ Why join Joveo** 




 You will help shape this capability while its operating choices are still taking form. Your decisions will influence the work we pursue, the leaders we hire and the standards customers experience.
 



 This role brings technical delivery and commercial responsibility together. If you have strong convictions about how complex AI programs should run, you will have the scope to build an organisation around them.
