 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 The Manager \- Ecommerce Transformation will drive ecommerce transformation initiatives within the Customer practice, combining digital commerce strategy, customer experience improvement, operating model design, and delivery excellence. The role will support clients in improving online growth, commerce operations, product discovery, conversion, order experience, and omnichannel effectiveness. You will work with business and technology stakeholders to shape commerce roadmaps, design scalable operating models, and implement transformation initiatives that improve revenue realization, digital adoption, customer experience, and operational efficiency.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Business Development \& Market Leadership
+ Support ecommerce transformation pipeline development across advisory, implementation, and managed transformation opportunities.
+ Contribute to proposals, RFP responses, business cases, demos, and executive presentations focused on digital commerce growth and operational improvement.
+ Support GTM strategies for ecommerce transformation offerings across B2B, B2C, and marketplace\-led business models.
+ Design and refine commerce transformation offerings aligned with client priorities, including digital channel growth, product data improvement, checkout optimization, and omnichannel enablement.
+ Contribute to thought leadership, client workshops, and points of view on ecommerce trends, digital buying behaviour, platform modernization, and commerce operating model evolution.


* Client Engagement \& Delivery
+ Lead ecommerce transformation workstreams from current\-state assessment through strategy, roadmap design, implementation planning, and execution support.
+ Assess commerce journeys, digital storefronts, product information flows, merchandising processes, search and navigation, order management touchpoints, and performance metrics to identify improvement opportunities.
+ Design ecommerce operating models, governance structures, product data processes, merchandising workflows, channel strategies, and performance management frameworks.
+ Support initiatives across product discovery, catalog readiness, personalization, pricing and promotions, cart and checkout, order visibility, returns experience, and customer support integration.
+ Partner with product, technology, data, marketing, sales, and operations teams to translate commerce priorities into structured requirements, process flows, user stories, and delivery roadmaps.
+ Develop business cases and benefits models to quantify conversion improvement, revenue uplift, digital adoption, cost\-to\-serve reduction, and operational productivity gains.
+ Ensure delivery excellence across assigned workstreams, including scope, timeline, budget, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder alignment.
+ Support change management, adoption, and governance activities to embed sustainable commerce capabilities across business teams.


* Technology \& Innovation
+ Enable teams to leverage ecommerce platforms, product information management systems, order management systems, CRM, analytics, personalization tools, automation, and AI\-enabled insights.
+ Stay ahead of technology trends shaping ecommerce transformation, including composable commerce, headless architecture, AI\-enabled product discovery, personalization, digital shelf analytics, and omnichannel orchestration.
+ Identify opportunities to develop reusable accelerators for commerce journey assessment, product data maturity, conversion diagnostics, and benefits tracking.


* Leadership \& People Development
+ Manage project teams or workstreams and ensure high\-quality delivery across ecommerce transformation engagements.
+ Mentor consultants and analysts on ecommerce strategy, requirements structuring, delivery governance, and cross\-functional stakeholder management.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Ideally, you’ll also**
* Demonstrate knowledge of digital commerce capabilities, including B2B and B2C commerce, marketplace models, dealer and distributor portals, and subscription commerce.
* Have exposure to leading commerce platforms and ecosystems, including Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Adobe Commerce, Shopify, SAP Commerce Cloud, commerce tools, BigCommerce, Akeneo, Salsify, and similar technologies.


**What We Look For**
* 8\+ years of experience in ecommerce transformation, digital commerce, omnichannel strategy, customer experience, product data transformation, or commerce operations.
* Consulting experience is desired.
* Proven experience supporting or leading ecommerce transformation programs, digital channel improvement initiatives, or commerce operating model redesign.
* Strong understanding of ecommerce journeys, digital merchandising, product information management, order experience, conversion optimization, and commerce performance metrics.
* Hands\-on experience with ecommerce platforms, analytics tools, PIM, OMS, CRM, or related digital commerce technologies.
* Strong business development support, stakeholder management, communication, and project delivery skills.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

 We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
 **Product Delivery Manager \- Custody / Asset Servicing.**

The successful candidate will assist in gathering requirements, analysing processes, and coordinating project activities to ensure the effective execution of product enhancements, regulatory changes, and client\-driven projects.
* Project Support: Assist in the coordination and execution of custody product initiatives, tracking progress and supporting the achievement of project milestones.

* Process Analysis: Analyse existing processes and workflows, identify opportunities for improvement, and support the development of efficient solutions.
* Documentation: Prepare and maintain project documentation, including requirements, process maps, test cases, and user guides.
* Testing Support: Assist with user acceptance testing (UAT), including test planning, execution, and issue tracking to ensure solutions meet business needs.
* Stakeholder Communication: Support effective communication between business, technology, operations, and other teams to ensure alignment throughout the project lifecycle.
* Regulatory Compliance: Help ensure initiatives comply with relevant regulatory requirements and internal policies. Continuous Improvement: Contribute to the enhancement of delivery processes and best practices within the team.


**To Be Successful, You Will**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in business, Finance, Technology, Data/Analytics, or a related field.
* 8\+ years’ experience in product management / product delivery, business analysis, or change delivery within financial services, ideally within Securities Services / Custody and Asset Servicing. Demonstrable domain knowledge across Asset Servicing, including Corporate Actions and Income Processing (end\-to\-end lifecycle, key controls, and client impacts).
* Strong understanding of data concepts and operating models, with experience delivering or partnering on Data Platform capabilities and data\-led product outcomes. Proven experience working with Client Reference Data and Asset Reference Data (data quality, governance, lineage, controls, and downstream consumer impacts).
* Hands\-on or delivery experience with Xceptor (or comparable workflow/data automation tooling) to improve STP (Straight Through Processing), reduce risk, and enhance operational efficiency. Strong understanding of custody operations, securities processing, and the applicable regulatory environment; ability to translate regulatory and risk requirements into product features and controls. Xceptor: experience designing/implementing workflows, exception management, and controls automation to improve STP (Straight Through Processing) and operational resilience. Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills; comfortable working with complex datasets and process flows to identify root causes and drive fixes.
* Track record of working effectively in cross\-functional teams (Operations, Technology, Data, Risk/Compliance, Client Coverage) and driving outcomes through influence. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex operational and data topics clearly to senior stakeholders and delivery teams.
* Asset Servicing expertise: strong functional knowledge of custody/asset servicing processes, controls, and client outcomes. Corporate Actions: event lifecycle understanding (announcement through entitlement), processing variants, exception handling, and client reporting considerations. Income Processing: coupon/dividend lifecycle, tax considerations (where relevant), breaks management, and reconciliation touchpoints.
* Data Platform delivery: ability to define requirements, prioritise platform capabilities, and align product outcomes to data architecture and operating model constraints. Reference Data management: practical experience with Client Reference Data and Asset Reference Data including data quality metrics, remediation approaches, governance, and stewardship models.
* Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills; ability to partner across Technology, Operations, Data, and Risk to deliver at pace. Delivery discipline: ability to manage multiple workstreams, deadlines, and dependencies, with a focus on measurable outcomes. Clear, structured communicator with strong documentation skills (business requirements, operating model changes, controls, and executive updates). Proactive, continuous\-improvement mindset with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

**Position Overview:**
 Regional Surface Head role is accountable for the end\-to\-end governance, performance, and optimization of the Surface Network, SFC Hub Operations, Surface Fleet, and First Mile (PUD) Operations across multiple states.
   

  

 Owns regional Surface Hub performance, transportation efficiency, fleet utilization, First Mile integration, network flow, service quality, productivity, and cost optimization to ensure seamless movement of shipments from pickup through middle\-mile transportation.
   

  

 Leads Regional Surface Fleet \& Network Managers, Regional Senior Manager – PUD Operations, and Regional SFC Hub Managers, driving operational consistency, standardized execution, infrastructure readiness, and continuous improvement across all Surface operations within the region.
   

  

 Acts as the regional owner for Surface Operations by integrating Hub Operations, Fleet \& Network Management, and PUD Operations to deliver superior service quality, operational excellence, and cost efficiency.
   

  

 This role operates as a regional capability and governance function, working closely with Air Network, CPU Operations, Last Mile Operations, Engineering, Finance, Commercial, and Network Planning teams to ensure a reliable, scalable, and cost\-effective logistics network.
   

  

**Job Purpose:**
 To build and operate a high\-performing Surface Operations network by integrating SFC Hub Operations, Surface Fleet \& Network, and First Mile (PUD) Operations, while driving operational excellence, service quality, transportation efficiency, hub productivity, customer experience, and cost optimization across the region.
   

  

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**

* Translate national Surface Operations strategies into region\-specific execution plans.
* Drive continuous improvement across Surface Hub Operations, Surface Fleet \& Network, and First Mile Operations.


**Leadership**

* Provide strategic direction and governance across Surface Hub Operations, Surface Fleet \& Network, and First Mile (PUD) Operations, ensuring seamless integration and standardized execution throughout the regional Surface Network.
* Drive operational excellence by improving hub throughput, transportation efficiency, fleet utilization, pickup productivity, infrastructure readiness, and end\-to\-end network performance.
* Build leadership capability, succession pipeline, and operational bench strength while fostering a high\-performance culture across all Surface Operations functions.
* Drive collaboration between Surface Operations, CPU, Air Network, Last Mile, Commercial, Engineering, Finance, HR, and other cross\-functional teams to achieve regional service and business objectives.
* Ensure consistent implementation of national operational strategies, governance frameworks, and best practices across all regional Surface Operations.


**Operational Excellence**
* Own and govern operational performance across Surface Hubs, Surface Fleet \& Network, and First Mile Operations.
* Drive network optimization through improved routing, fleet utilization, hub productivity, and transportation planning.
* Ensure seamless integration between First Mile, Middle Mile, and downstream operations to improve service quality and operational efficiency.
* Establish standardized operating practices across all Surface Operations while ensuring compliance with SOPs, safety, and regulatory requirements.
* Monitor regional operational performance, identify bottlenecks, and implement corrective actions to improve network productivity and service performance.


**Cost Optimization \& Efficiency**
* Drive transportation and operational cost optimization through improved fleet utilization, route optimization, manpower productivity, and infrastructure utilization.
* Monitor cost per shipment and identify opportunities to improve regional operating efficiency.
* Balance cost optimization initiatives with customer service commitments and operational reliability.


**Process Re\-engineering \& Continuous Improvement**
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives to improve productivity, service quality, and transportation efficiency.
* Drive standardization of operational processes across Surface Hubs, Fleet Operations, and PUD Operations.
* Implement scalable operating models to support business growth and peak season readiness.


**Stakeholder \& Governance**

* Ensure alignment between regional execution and national operational strategy.
* Act as the regional SME for Surface Operations in internal governance forums and strategic discussions.

* Experience: 12–15 years of experience in logistics operations with strong exposure to Surface Transportation, Hub Operations, Fleet Management, First Mile Operations, and Multi\-location Operations.
* Proven experience in managing large cross\-functional teams across multiple locations.
* Exposure to network optimization, transportation planning, and cost management preferred.

title: RnD Program Management
description:
**About the Role:** 




  





 A product/technology begins from the mind and the mind is the product of the environment it is in. The mind thinks with what it experiences from its environment. An organization is the converging environment for such wide variety of minds to come together and contribute their ideas.
 



  





 Yet every organization underestimates the amount of Facilitation and Organizing that is needed to ensure a conducive flow of Ideasbetween minds.
 



  





 We are looking for an Engineering/Technical Program Manager who will own the engineering delivery system and the people performance diagnostic layer across CynLr’s multi\-disciplinary engineering organization. This is not a project management role that runs Agile ceremonies. This is a role for someone who can design engineering processes from first principles, build objective performance assessment frameworks, diagnose systemic bottlenecks across hardware\-software\-research workflows, and drive alignment across teams with genuine interpersonal skill.
 



  





 You will design \& execute the processes, frameworks, and diagnostics that allow CynLr’s engineering teams to deliver with clarity, speed, and accountability across every stream.
 



  





**Your Primary Contributions** 




  





*1\. Engineering Process Design \& Delivery* 



* Design and own the end\-to\-end product delivery process from concept through design, development, testing, and release across hardware, firmware, software, and research streams.
* Map inter\-stream dependencies, tool workflows, and external/internal bottlenecks and resolve them before they become blockers.
* Set up milestones with built\-in assessment checkpoints for product development, projects, and design work.
* Design and manage the tool workflow for product delivery (Asana and engineering management tools), driving adoption and discipline across teams.
* Build a distinct R\&D management workflow for research and exploratory projects separate from routine software development processes.



  





*2\. Engineering Review Process* 



* Design the engineering review process for Design, Development, and Research across all engineering streams.
* Define review metrics, assess process effectiveness, and refine iteratively.
* Organize and conduct review sessions where engineering leads assess the work. You will design, structure, and run the process.



  





*3\. Performance Diagnostics \& Assessment* 



* Design an analytics\-driven continuous assessment process by weaving diagnostic probes into engineering workflows making performance reviews objective rather than subjective.
* Structure performance assessment across three dimensions: Individual, Team, and Process ensuring root causes are diagnosable across all three.
* Diagnose performance issues to their root: Process gap? Tooling gap? Motivation? Skill gap? Design specific remedies for each.
* Formulate monthly performance reports and conduct quarterly assessment programs in collaboration with HR.



  





*4\. Resource \& Project Planning* 



* Maintain resource maps, skill maps, and performance grades and use them actively for project planning and allocation decisions.
* Organize individual engineers’ calendars with categorized task blocks and drive adherence.
* Manage project timelines, dependencies, and delivery commitments across streams.



  





 5\.
 *Team Alignment \& People Skills* 



* Drive alignment across engineering teams not through authority, but through clarity, negotiation, and building shared understanding.
* Handle individual negotiations, identify morale bottlenecks, and resolve conflicts across teams.
* Build team cohesion and soft\-skill development as a deliberate practice, not a cultural afterthought.



  





**What Will You Do?** 




 You will augment Founder's Vision and make CynLr’s engineering organization legible to itself, to leadership, and to the people inside it.
 



 You will:
 


* Translate ambiguity into structure without losing the nuance that makes deep\-tech hard.
* Surface bottlenecks before they surface themselves as missed deadlines.
* Build systems that make good engineering behavior the path of least resistance.
* Diagnose performance problems at their root and not just at their symptom.
* Hold the delivery system together across hardware, firmware, software, and research without becoming a bottleneck yourself.



 You are not expected to be a domain expert in every engineering stream. You are expected to understand how they interlock and to design \& execute accordingly.
 



  





**What This Role Is Not** 



* Not an Agile/Scrum Master role. We do not use template frameworks. You will design processes from first principles based on what the engineering organization actually needs.
* Not a passive PMO. You will not track Gantt charts from the sidelines. You will actively diagnose, intervene, and drive systemic improvements.
* Not a pure HR role. While you will collaborate with HR on performance programs, your primary orientation is engineering operations and process design.



  





**What Will You Need to Do This Role Well** 



* At least 3–5 years of owning engineering processes end\-to\-end — not just participating in them.
* Strong understanding of multiple engineering streams (hardware, firmware, software, research) and their interlinkings dependency patterns, bottleneck dynamics, and cross\-stream risk.
* Demonstrated experience designing delivery processes, milestone frameworks, and assessment systems from scratch
* Hands\-on experience with engineering program management tools (Asana strongly preferred).
* Analytical mindset with the ability to design diagnostic probes and data\-driven assessment frameworks.
* Strong interpersonal skills: conflict resolution, individual negotiation, team alignment.



  





**Experience That Will Accelerate You** 



* Engineering degree with a technical career foundation before moving into program or process roles.
* Experience in deep\-tech, robotics, embedded systems, automotive, aerospace/defense, industrial automation, medical devices, or semiconductor equipment
* Experience in organizations with 30–150 engineers where process had to be built, not just followed.
* Comfort operating in a founder\-driven environment with high ownership expectations and minimal bureaucratic scaffolding.
* Background in a product company that ships integrated hardware\-software products.



  





**How Will You Do It?** 




 This role resists templating by design. When we build a new industry from Scratch, we can't do by borrowing tools from other professions/industries.
 



  





 You will operate by:
 



 • Studying the engineering organization as a system before intervening in it.
 



 • Asking sharp clarifying questions before designing solutions.
 



 • Building your own frameworks for tracking, diagnostics, and follow\-through.
 



 • Knowing when to enforce structure and when structure itself is the bottleneck.
 



 • Learning from feedback quickly and evolving your approach as the organization grows.
 



*Success here comes from systems thinking, engineering understanding, and the discipline to build things that outlast your direct involvement.* 




  





**Team Structure** 




 The Technical Program Manager operates within the Founder’s Office, embedded directly into the engineering organization.
 



 While the TPM works closely with the founder(s), the role interfaces continuously with:
 



 • Engineering leads
 



 • HR and Talent, for performance programs and people\-related interventions
 



 • Finance and Operations, for resource planning and project budgeting
 



 • External vendors and tooling partners, where applicable
 



 The TPM owns process design and delivery hygiene across all engineering streams — acting as the connective layer that keeps multi\-disciplinary teams aligned without creating dependency on a single coordination point.
 



  





**About CynLr** 




 Just like a baby’s brain, CynLr Visual Intelligence stack makes Robots to instinctively see \& pick any object under any ambience, without any training. (a demo video link).
 



  





 From fitting a screw to removing object out of its the plastic wrapper to automating the assembly of a car/gadget \- every such object handling task that involves "adapting on the fly" is not prior trainable \& thereby remains non\-automatable across the industries. CynLr builds a stack of Micro RL blocks called Sensing \& Action Primitives, using which a High Level Task can be composed.
 



  





 CynLr's OI enables an universal alternative to custom automation thus simplifying factory lines into
 *modular LEGO\-like* 
 Universal\-factories that can be rapidly reconfigured as products change.
 



  





 CynLr’ s Vision and ML stacks are
 *deeply inspired by neuroscience,* 
 modelling how biological vision understands shape, geometry, and interaction rather than appearance alone. To support this, CynLr builds its hardware, sensors, compute pipelines, and learning stacks from scratch, tightly coupling perception, decision\-making, and action.
 



  





 We are a deep\-tech robotics company at the intersection of computer vision, real\-time control systems, and precision hardware, headquartered in Bengaluru with a Swiss entity. Our engineering spans optics, embedded systems, firmware, real\-time software, mechanical design, and applied research.

description:
**Description**
 The Worldwide Operations Security (WWOS) Global Security Operations Center (GSOC) is Amazon’s 24/7 centralized command center supporting Worldwide Amazon Stores. The GSOC manages critical incidents impacting life safety, operational continuity, and brand reputation by connecting sites with the appropriate subject matter experts and coordinating end\-to\-end incident response. We accomplish this by creating policy and implementation guidelines; training leadership and staff; using technology to eliminate subjectivity, complexity, and variation; identifying, preparing for, and mitigating risk; and auditing our practices to ensure compliance.
   

  

 The Security Operations Manager, Global Security Operations Center (GSOC) will provides critical support and timely notification to global partners regarding incidents that have impacted, or have the potential to impact, Life Safety, Operations, and/or the Amazon Brand. They will assist in managerial ownership of their shift and be responsible for ensuring performance SLAs are met, that responses are appropriate according to policies and procedures, and for developing and motivating a highly performant staff. The Security Operations Manager must also deal effectively with ambiguity and make response\-related decisions sometimes with incomplete information in the best interest of Amazon.
   

  

 The successful candidate must have a proven record of effective leadership capabilities and demonstrate elevated judgment while operating under pressure. They must possess the ability to operate autonomously, use discretion when dealing with sensitive and critical information, and apply sound business principles to identify barriers and initiate actions to resolve. The candidate should possess a proven record of working across multiple organizations to resolve escalations where the problem and solutions, as well as risk strategy, may not be well defined.
   

  

 The GSOC is a 24/7/365 operation, and this position will require shift work, including night and weekend shifts.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Lead 24/7 GSOC shift operations, ensuring timely triage, escalation, and resolution of incidents impacting life safety, operational continuity, and Amazon’s brand.
* Provide timely notifications, situation reports, and executive briefings to global stakeholders
* Ensure shift operational excellence by maintaining ownership of performance, achieving established Service Level Agreements (SLAs), and driving consistent execution of policies and procedures
* Partner with Security, Operations, HR, Workplace Health \& Safety (WHS), Legal, Communications and other internal stakeholders to coordinate effective incident response and business continuity support.
* Lead, coach, and develop a high\-performing team of Operations Security Specialists by setting clear expectations, providing regular coaching and feedback, and fostering a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous learning.
* Monitor incident trends, operational metrics, and emerging risks to identify opportunities for process improvements, strengthen response capabilities, and reduce recurring issues.
* Lead post\-incident reviews and drive corrective actions that improve operational resilience, standardize best practices, and enhance the effectiveness of global incident management.
* Partner with cross\-functional and global teams to develop, implement, and continuously improve processes, tools, and operational standards that support scalable, efficient GSOC operations.
* Maintain the highest standards of professionalism, sound judgment, confidentiality, and customer obsession while protecting Amazon’s associates, operations, and brand.


 A day in the life
   

  

 As a GSOC Security Operations Manager, you will lead a team responsible for managing critical security and operational incidents across Amazon’s global network. Your day may include directing responses to workplace emergencies, severe weather events, security threats, transportation incidents, or operational disruptions while coordinating with multiple business partners and executive stakeholders. You will coach your team in real time, provide strategic guidance during escalations, ensure operational metrics are met, and continuously improve processes that strengthen Amazon’s global incident management capability.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* 6\+ years of compliance, audit or risk management experience
* 3\+ years of people management experience
* Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, SharePoint, and PowerPoint)
* Experience in critical incident management, emergency response and business continuity within operations or logistics environments
* Ability to use multiple software applications simultaneously while managing critical incidents
* Ability to work rotational shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience leading people in a Security/Emergency Operations Center environment
* Military/intelligence/law enforcement/geopolitical risk analysis experience
* 
* Professional certifications such as CPP, PSP, CBCP, CEM, or equivalent.
* 
* Strong verbal and written communication skills including ability to write clearly and succinctly for senior leadership
* 
* Experience in leading and developing multidisciplinary teams in fast\-paced operational environments

 As the GCM Evidence Generation function matures and direct report lines stabilize, the focus of the role will transition to leading and managing a team that is focused on Strategy and Ops Enablement across GMA Therapeutic Areas and functions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
**Initial Capability Build Evidence \& Governance Records Maintenance, Quality, \& Statistical Analysis:**
* In the initial build phase, directly oversee the design and establishment of evidence record management, governance records management, quality and compliance, and statistical analysis processes within the GCM, in close coordination with Global Evidence Generation before full GCM transition
* Provide active direction, coaching, and quality oversight to Strategy \& Operations Leads, Quality and Compliance Leads, Data Governance \& Systems Leads, and Statistical Analysis Leads as they establish GCM processes, standards, and tooling from the ground up

* Facilitate reporting line transfers to the Evidence Generation Study Execution \& Data Group Lead once that structure is operational, ensuring continuity of process ownership and no loss of compliance or delivery quality during the transition
* Act as the senior quality reviewer of evidence \& governance record centralization, quality, and statistical analysis activities during the initial build phase, before team capacity is fully established

**Evidence Strategy \& Planning Operations Oversight:**

* Oversee the end\-to\-end establishment, quality and consistency of all GCM operations enablement outputs across the team's full scope once at steady state including financial operations, study operations, and quality control and maintenance

title: Content Operations Manager - Center Of Excellence
description:
Groupon connects 42 million customers with local experiences \- restaurants, events, wellness and travel \- and the million\-plus merchants who deliver them. Our mission is to get people offline and into the real world at prices that make it possible. We're an AI\-native company in the middle of a platform transformation, moving from a deals marketplace to an experience discovery platform that works for customers and merchants at the same time.
   

  

 Groupon is building a Center of Excellence in Bengaluru, and we need Content Operations Managers who own quality end\-to\-end. AI now writes the first draft — your job is to be the judgment layer that makes it excellent, accurate, and trustworthy. You'll QA AI\-generated content, hand\-craft the marquee deals that carry the brand, and fix content escalations rather than just flagging them. If you've got a sharp editorial eye, work fluently alongside AI tools, and take ownership all the way to publish — this role is for you.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* QA and proofread AI\-drafted content before it goes live, correcting issues in place
* Give structured feedback that helps our AI content tools improve week over week
* Hand\-craft marquee, high\-value deals (think Disneyland, Starbucks) end\-to\-end
* Own content escalations from Sales, Merchant Service, and Customer Service — fix titles, descriptions, images, and fine print directly
* Run the language\-quality queue and hold the bar for language standards
* Take on redemption, merchant\-service admin, and content\-specialist tasks as they consolidate into the team
* Turn recurring content issues into policy, SOP, or AI\-prompt improvements
* Help decide which tasks get automated next
* Keep every piece of content on\-brand, accurate, and transparent
* Partner across Sales, Merchant Service, Customer Service, Design, and Product
* Track and share quality signals and trends for leadership


**What You'll Bring**
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, or a related field; advanced English (C1–C2\)
* Proven senior experience in content, editorial, or content QA — high volume, accuracy\-focused
* Exceptional editing and proofreading skills with a strong sense of house style
* End\-to\-end ownership — you fix it, not just flag it
* A root\-cause mindset for recurring defects
* Comfort tracking defect types, escalation volume, and turnaround time
* Fluency (or a fast ramp\-up) with AI content tools, and willingness to help calibrate them
* Working knowledge of HTML and Markdown; comfort with visual\-template changes
* Adaptability in a fast\-changing, high\-automation environment


**Must Have**
* Availability aligned with United States shift hours


**Nice to Have**
* Familiarity with Groupon's markets and deal lifecycle


**Groupon** 
**is an AI\-First Company**
 We’re committed to building smarter, faster, and more innovative ways of working and AI plays a key role in how we get there. We encourage candidates to
 **leverage AI tools** 
 during the hiring process where it adds value, and we’re always keen to hear how technology improves the way you work. If you’re passionate about AI or curious to explore how it can elevate your role
 **you’ll be right at home here.**
 Groupon’s purpose is to build strong communities through thriving small businesses. To learn more about the world’s largest local e\-commerce marketplace, click here. You can also find out more about us in the latest Groupon news as well as learning about our DEI approach. If all of this sounds like something that’s a great fit for you, then click apply and join us on a mission to become the ultimate destination for local experiences and services.
   

  

**Beware of Recruitment Fraud:** 
 Groupon follows a merit\-based recruitment process without charging job seekers any fees. We've noticed an increase in recruitment fraud, including fake job postings and fraudulent interviews and job offers aimed at stealing personal information or money. Be cautious of individuals falsely representing Groupon's Talent Acquisition team with fake job offers. If you encounter any suspicious job offers or interview calls demanding money, recognize these as scams. Groupon is not responsible for losses from such dealings. The role oversees end\-to\-end supply chain operations including procurement, parts planning, logistics, inventory management, warehouse operations, RMA management, maintenance contract support, and project execution. In addition to managing India domestic operations, the role supports global customer accounts in collaboration with EXEO America and EXEO Europe, providing operational coverage aligned to Europe and America time zones.

* Supply Chain Leadership \& Team Management in India
* Lead and manage Supply Chain operation in India
* Provide leadership, coaching, and performance management for supply chain personnel.
* Act as the primary escalation point for supply chain issues within India. · Establish KPIs, governance, and operational controls.
* Ensure operational readiness to support customer projects and maintenance contracts.
* International Customer Management \& Strategic Accounts
* Serve as the primary supply chain contact for international customers.
* Support strategic international customers and global accounts across multiple regions.
* Participate in customer reviews, project meetings, and operational governance discussions.

* Support Europe and America time\-zone coverage requirements.

* Negotiate pricing and support cost optimization initiatives.
* Manage purchase orders, supplier performance, and lead\-time follow\-up. Logistics \& Cross\-Border Operations
* Oversee inbound and outbound shipments across multiple countries.
* Manage freight forwarders, customs brokers, and logistics partners.
* Ensure timely and compliant movement of goods.
* Inventory, Warehouse \& Service Parts Management· Ensure inventory accuracy and warehouse governance.
* Monitor spare parts readiness for SLA and maintenance contracts.
* Coordinate stock movements between local and overseas warehouses. RMA, Warranty \& After\-Sales Support
* Manage end\-to\-end RMA and warranty activities.
* Coordinate with vendors and service teams for resolution.
* Monitor DOA and RMA performance trends.
* Compliance, Trade \& Regulatory Management
* Ensure compliance with import/export regulations.
* Support permits, customs clearance, and trade compliance activities. ·
* Identify and mitigate compliance risks.
* Manage strategic suppliers, 3PLs, and service partners.
* Conduct supplier performance reviews and SLA management.
* Identify opportunities for cost reduction and operational efficiency.
* Reporting \& Continuous Improvement
* Prepare management reports covering inventory, logistics, RMA, service readiness, and costs.
* Drive process improvement and standardization initiatives.
* Maintain audit readiness and documentation governance.



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* Minimum 8 years of progressive supply chain experience, with at least 3 years in a regional or multi\-country management role.
* Demonstrated track record in vendor management, logistics operations, and end\-to\-end supply chain management across multiple markets.
* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Professional certification in supply chain management (e.g. CSCMP, APICS CSCP, CIPS, or equivalent) is advantageous.

 Full\-time, on\-ground

 ₹30,000 per month, depending on experience and fit

 Sales incentives, growth opportunities, and other perks as the role evolves
 



  





 What You’ll Do
 



 Be the welcoming face and energy\-holder of the away bangalore hub.
 



 Handle daily operations with ownership, including opening and closing checklists, issue resolution, member support, cleanliness, and space readiness.
 



 Manage vendors, housekeeping, pantry supplies, repairs, maintenance, and day\-to\-day operational tasks with precision.

 Who You Are
 



 Warm, confident, energetic, and smart. These are non\-negotiable.
 



 You enjoy meeting people, hosting them, solving problems, and making a space feel welcoming.

 Compensation

title: Procurement Logistics Manager
description:
**About Humyn Labs** 




 Humyn Labs builds the intelligence layer for physical\-world AI — systems that perceive, reason, and act in real environments. Our work sits at the intersection of egocentric video understanding, embodied AI, robotics perception, and voice\-driven interaction. We move fast, obsess over data quality, and ship at scale.
 



  





 Humyn Labs converts human action \- across sound, sight, movement, and touch \- into high\-quality multi\-modal data signals for physical AI. Operating across 20\+ countries in India, southeast Asia, Latin America, and the Middle East: the real\-world environments where physical AI deploys, not the labs where it is built.
 



  





 Our data isn't just collected; it's evaluated, defended, and production\-ready. Because before AI can be trusted, its training data must be.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We're looking for a Procurement \& Logistics Manager to own hardware procurement, logistics, base setup, and troubleshooting across our operations. This role is central to keeping bases equipped and running \- from sourcing the right electronics/hardware components (including from China) to ensuring smooth logistics between BLR and base locations. You'll work very closely with the Data Upload Pod, since the Data Upload Center functions as the Base HQ.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own end\-to\-end procurement of hardware/electronics components required for base setup and operations (cameras, SD cards, storage devices, networking equipment, etc.)
* Build and maintain a strong sourcing network in China/Other location for electronics procurement \- identifying reliable suppliers/manufacturers, negotiating pricing, and managing vendor relationships
* Manage logistics and shipment coordination between BLR and base sites \- ensuring hardware reaches bases on time, in good condition, and within budget
* Lead new base setup from a hardware/logistics standpoint \- procurement planning, equipment installation coordination, and readiness checks
* Provide general troubleshooting support for hardware/logistics issues across bases (damaged equipment, shipment delays, stock shortages)
* Work closely with the Data Upload Pod to align hardware availability (SD cards, storage, upload equipment) with 24x7 upload operations and T\+1 TAT requirements
* Maintain inventory tracking, reorder points, and vendor documentation (invoices,import/customs paperwork, warranties)
* Evaluate cost\-saving opportunities in sourcing and logistics without compromising quality or timelines
* Coordinate customs/import processes for hardware sourced internationally



  





**Requirements** 



* 3–6 years of experience in procurement, supply chain, or logistics — ideally with hands\-on electronics/hardware sourcing experience
* Strong existing network of suppliers/vendors in China for electronics procurement

title: Manager, Customer Support & Training
description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.
   

  

**The Role**
 The Manager, Customer Support and Training will oversee a team of support engineers who provide technical support to customers who use AspenTech Digital Grid Management (DGM) software. Managers are responsible for ensuring the support team resolves customer issues according to the Service Level Objectives (SLO) with a high satisfaction level, ensuring any customer experience is delivered to high quality standards and executing other department projects as required.
   

  

**Your Impact**
* Manage a team of support engineers providing customer issue resolution. This includes staffing, performance management, and employee development.
* Ensure the team of technical consultants provides timely and expert customer support to resolve a wide range of product usage and application issues for our customers, primarily through ticketing system, telephone, chat, and remote access.
* Ensure technical support team follows department processes and guidelines.
* Make quick and sound decisions to handle and escalate critical problems that impact customers’ operating facilities but are not solvable by normal support practices.
* Manage day\-to\-day operations, including interfacing directly with customers as needed, and training new employees.
* Work as a member of the CS\&T management team to ensure departmental metrics are achieved.
* Ensure customer training gaps are outlined and handed off to Account Management and Training through standard processes.
* Function as an expert on DGM product line of software to mentor and train new support engineers.
* Coach and develop a strong team to deliver product training and solution demonstrations to customers, with the goal of driving usage, adoption and growth.
* Act as an escalation point for level 1 escalations when support tickets exist SLO to develop a plan to bring to swift resolution.
* Liaise with various departments to ensure progress where additional expertise is needed.
* Regularly review processes for opportunities to gain efficiencies through technology and automation.
* Support global regions with triage and intake best practices.


 What You'll Need
   

  

* Minimum requirement \- bachelor’s degree in engineering or related technical field.
* 8–10 years of overall experience in the Power, Utilities, or Automation industries, with at least 2 years of team management experience.
* Familiarity with public Power and utilities Industries for Digital Grid Management \& Technologies.
* Knowledge of computer programming preferred.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written.
* Occasional domestic and international travel is required (10%).
* Strong analytic and problem\-solving skills.
* Highly energetic with strong initiative. Works with a sense of urgency and inspires others to do the same.

This role will be responsible for driving the Consumer Rev Ops team towards operational excellence by being a versatile, dynamic team\-player who can wear multiple hats \& drive key initiatives across workstreams. title: Human Resources Operations Manager
description:
**Role:** 
 HR \& Finance Manager
 



**Function:** 
 Human Resources \& Finance
 



**Location:** 
 Bangalore
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Industry:** 
 Information Technology \& Services, Artificial Intelligence, Critical Infrastructure
 



  





**About Company** 




 A research\-first AI company incubated at the Indian Institute of Science (IISc). It builds advanced AI for the planning and operations of critical networks.
 



 Its core technology is a World Model that augments LLMs to reason about network state and dependencies — even with incomplete information. The founding team has raised over $100M in prior ventures and published at leading AI research venues.
 



 The company has just closed its seed round and is at the zero\-to\-one stage of building.
 



  





**Position Overview** 




 This is a hands\-on, dual\-function role that builds and runs the people and finance backbone of the company. Reporting directly to the founders, you will independently own HR operations, payroll, statutory compliance, and day\-to\-day accounting — creating the systems and processes that let the technical team focus on frontier AI. At a company of this stage, you won't inherit a playbook; you'll write it.
 



  





**Role \& Responsibilities** 



* Own the full employee lifecycle — onboarding, records management, leave/attendance tracking, and offboarding — ensuring a seamless experience at every stage.
* Process monthly payroll accurately and on time; manage all statutory filings and compliance for PF, ESI, PT, and TDS without exception.
* Maintain books of accounts in Tally — covering invoicing, vendor bills, accounts payable/receivable, and monthly bank reconciliations.
* Support monthly MIS preparation, cash\-flow tracking, budgeting inputs, GST filings, and coordination with statutory auditors.
* Coordinate recruitment logistics, HR policy rollout, performance management tracking, and employee engagement initiatives.
* Manage office administration, vendor contracts, and relationships with external stakeholders including legal teams, banks, and the Company Secretary.
* Build scalable HR and finance systems and documentation (policy guidebooks, trackers, SOPs) in partnership with the founders.



  





**Must Have Criteria** 



* 2–6 years of experience in an HR generalist or HR operations role with direct exposure to finance and accounts.
* Hands\-on working knowledge of Tally for day\-to\-day bookkeeping — invoicing, AP/AR, and bank reconciliations.
* Demonstrated ability to independently process payroll and manage statutory compliance filings: PF, ESI, PT, and TDS.
* Bachelor's degree in Commerce (B.Com) or a related field.
* Prior experience setting up or maintaining HR systems — attendance/leave trackers, onboarding/offboarding workflows, and compliance records — in a lean team environment.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* M.Com or MBA (HR or Finance) preferred.
* Prior experience in a startup or early\-stage company where you operated across both HR and finance functions simultaneously.
* Familiarity with GST filing processes and coordination with statutory auditors.
* Exposure to building HR/finance documentation from scratch — policy guidebooks, SOPs, or process playbooks.



  





**What We Offer** 



* Direct access and reporting line to the founders — high visibility and influence over how the company is built.
* Opportunity to design and own the people and finance function from the ground up at a seed\-stage, IISc\-incubated AI company.
* Work at the intersection of frontier AI and critical infrastructure — a mission with long\-term national and global significance.
* Lean, high\-ownership environment where your work has immediate, measurable impact on the organisation.
